bibliographic.title: Slay the Wickham
bibliographic.author: kaetts
bibliographic.description:
For slights of honour, grievous impropriety, and the possession of a most rakish nature, Mr. Wickham must die. You must slay him!

A frivolous Pride and Prejudice themed text-based game of roughly 3k words total across 6 unique endings. Made for as a gift for a friend, hosting here for posterity. Fullscreen recommended. Go forth and slay!
